youtube.title: Why Onions Make You Cry 🧅 #Shorts
youtube.description:
When you cut an onion, it fights back with a chemical weapon.

Cutting an onion breaks its cells, letting enzymes make an irritating gas (syn-propanethial S-oxide). It reaches your eyes, irritates the nerves, and your tear glands flood them to wash it out. Chill the onion and use a sharp knife.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
